behavior: One sealed committed capture and independently admitted stable installation build root, five toolkit roles and pure observation service; the root is not a sixth toolkit role.

Fourteen reviewed Dash SQL/template reads embed regular captured fatal-UTF8 text, preserving BOM/CRLF/Unicode and literal physical-looking strings. Stable virtual module paths replace global emitted-text rewriting.
PUNI0.3 schema1 is strict and separate from historical0.2.1 bytes/readers; digest, source revision and release tag agree before current ordinary/lint/preparation admission.

Current ordinary execution selects native installation and toolkit2 before isolated typed child dispatch. Root lint and both preparations enter their existing signal/output owners; executable hard exit follows owner settlement.

Assembly owns capture, producer and metadata delivery under first cancellation, fresh protected roots, per-file readback, retained outputs and original/aggregate causes. Generated metadata exposes only bin.puni and no install hooks.

Actual Bun pack/add installs outside removed source/output trees under spaced paths and poisoned startup; Navigator, Burokrat, Dash storage, pure observation and actual stored MCP helper execute without first-party Bash/Node.

Producer-only validator marker selects its actual installed path unless a snapshot artifact manifest is present; unmarked source behavior remains unchanged. Actual installed observe/enforce and normal/relocation archives use full semantic certification of controlled candidates.
limits: Local package usability and byte readback do not establish clean-release provenance, root self-authentication, registry ownership or publication authority.
Operator installation/runtime/source metadata stability remains a premise. Fixed asset AST checks enforce the reviewed direct-read/import contract, not arbitrary JavaScript effects.
Linux/x64, pinned Bun1.4.4 and declared GNU tools only; no other-platform qualification.
Fourteen-file final regression supplements the unchanged-executable proof and the full2095-test frozen baseline; it does not imply the whole host gate ran.

Public build/pack/default/bootstrap/CI callers, all delegated installed leaves, helper-specific fault closure, complete script/client census and Bun conversion, WBS hierarchy and exact-SHA host gate/rollout remain open.
